_comment: F2 compat token conflict rejects pre-IO even with ACP sessionId present. RED via --validate-config.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false
bearer_session_compat = true

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"
session_header = "x-affinity"

[[models]]
name = "gem-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
name: m4_compat_gemini_conflict_with_acp
